prompt.zh-TW: 寫分錄之前先認科目。把初陽貿易會用到的這些科目放進正確的要素，想一想每一個增加時記哪一邊。
prompt.en: Before writing entries, identify the accounts. Sort these accounts used by First Light Trading into the right element, and think about which side each increases on.

explanation.zh-TW: 應收帳款與機器設備是資產（增加記借方）；短期借款是負債、未分配盈餘是股東權益（增加記貸方）；利息費用與包裝運送費屬於費損（增加記借方）。
explanation.en: Trade receivables and machinery and equipment are assets (increase on the debit side); short-term borrowings are a liability and unappropriated retained earnings are equity (increase on the credit side); finance costs and packing and delivery expenses are expenses (increase on the debit side).
